rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst and acknowledges image limitations, but it overstates confidence in ICM/TE detail and mentions features not clearly discernible on this single blurred focal plane.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor diagnosis, prior IVF outcomes, sperm parameters, BMI, and endometrium with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with probability estimates tied to favorable and unfavorable factors, though some deductions are somewhat speculative.

Core recommendations like SET and standard luteal support are guideline-concordant, but strong endorsement of PGT-A and broad RIF-style testing (ERA, NK cells, thrombophilia) in a 29-year-old after only two failures goes beyond routine evidence-based guidance.
Provides clear practical steps for current transfer and contingency planning, though some suggested investigations may be excessive for this stage.
